Solving handbook

One shared reference for the controls, the mathematics, and the algorithms behind every puzzle.

A legal turn permutes the puzzle’s addresses. We combine those turns into verified operations that preserve chosen colors or secure more of a solution. Reusable stabilizer chains supply a constructive route; short-operation caches and bounded searches improve it. Correctness and shortest distance are different guarantees.

Start with the illustrated controls, open the algorithm chapters for the full specification, or jump to the complete 2×2×2 example. Each game’s own guide contains its particular solution sequences and references.

References & further reading

These references concern permutation groups, constructive factorization, search, and complexity. Research about a particular puzzle is also listed in that puzzle’s own guide. A citation supplies context; it does not imply that this implementation reproduces every cited method or proves shortest solutions.
